title: Lesson 1: Introduction to Ol Chiki
description: Learn the historical origin and primary vowel inventory of Ol Chiki script.

sections.title: Vowels in Ol Chiki
sections.content: Pandit Raghunath Murmu created the Ol Chiki script in 1925 specifically designed for Santhali phonetics.
